name: Always Has Been
meaning: One astronaut looks at Earth and realizes something; a second astronaut behind him raises a gun. For a shocking realization that was actually true all along.
when_to_use: left = the realization, phrased "Wait, it's all [X]?" (next to the first astronaut). right = "Always has been" (above the astronaut with the gun). Keep right short; it is the punchline.
